title: Writing Premium on Named Non-Owner Policy Terms
content:
## In force
**Status condition.** Premium — premium written and additional premium alike — is written on a Named Non-Owner Policy term only while the term's status is bound, renewal offered or in force.

## Retired clauses and the current basis beside each

**(a)** ~~Premium written equals the full-term premium, once at binding and once at renewal acceptance.~~ — **no longer in force** as a general rule. Current basis: premium written on a renewal term that goes in force after its expiring term's expiration date, so that a lapse is recorded on the renewal term, is worked out under the company's late-renewal premium rule and only for such a renewal term; premium written at binding and on a renewal accepted on or before the expiring term's expiration date still equals the full-term premium, once at binding and once at renewal acceptance, and a renewal term with no lapse recorded keeps that figure.

**(b)** ~~A limits increase charges the full-term premium difference prorated over the term's days from its effective date; a reinstatement re-writes premium under the reinstatement rule.~~ — **no longer in force** as written. Current basis: the additional premium for a package change during the term is worked out under the company's package-change premium rule and booked as one additional-premium entry whose reason names the direction of the change: limits increase for a move to a package with a higher six-month base rate and limits decrease for a move to a package with a lower one; a move to a lower base rate whose increase charge under that rule is above zero is charged as additional premium and not returned, and only such a move; every other move to a lower base rate still returns unearned premium as a return-premium entry for the limits decrease, and a reinstatement still re-writes premium under the reinstatement rule.

| Term status | Premium may be written |
|---|---|
| bound | yes |
| renewal offered | yes |
| in force | yes |
| pending cancellation, cancelled, expired, not taken | no |

superseded_clauses: Premium written equals full_term_premium, once at binding and once at renewal acceptance.
A limits increase charges the full-term premium difference prorated over term_days from its effective date; a reinstatement re-writes premium under nonowner_reinstatement.
